title: Prepare one normalized collinear packet batch for the whole unknown even velocity
statement: For output |m|infty<=N choose ell=(1,2N+1,(2N+1)²), ensuring m.ell!=0 and m cross ell!=0. Known rational q_m=Pellperp m,a=q_m/|q_m|²,k=Qnell,l=m-k. For d perp m, Delta=2Qn(m.ell)-|m|², beta=-Qn|m|²(d.ell)/Delta, b=d-beta a+2beta m/|m|² yield a perp k,b perp l,Pm[(a.m)b+(b.m)a]=d, bounds |a|<=CN²,|b|<=CN6|d| for Q>=6N². Distinct tags isolate intended quadratic pairs/conjugates; higher tag relations paid by inverse-carrier remainder. Internal prepared parallel-sector two-frequency signal produces rho(t0)r with Lipschitz/short-time errors, no observed rho. First packet rho(t0)h_j and second preconditioned Rj cancel leading iQ²sigma²/[kappa rho(t0)(|k|²+|l|²)]. All normalization, elapsed time, code and carrier errors paid. Choose g so coefficient norm W<=sigma²/(4Ptag), then whole-catalogue decoder loads H+Z_N plus packet list and near-zero velocity. Actual computed registers define leading signal; logical errors propagate through known Q-independent polynomial map, only fresh physical errors get Q-dependent tolerance. One unforced window yields (W,H+Z_N), then amplify and add known U0N.
